newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Los Olivos District, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Los Olivos District, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Los Olivos Elementary School District, Santa Barbara County, California, intends to sell $1,150,000 principal amount of Los Olivos Elementary School District General Obligation Bonds, 1996 Election, Series A. Bids will be received on

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Dale Scott & Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA 94104, phone (415) 956-1030 or by facsimile at (415) 956-1322, and the sale will be awarded by the Superintendent of the Los Olivos Elementary School District or his designee on behalf of the Board of Trustees of the Los Olivos Elementary School District within twenty-six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Superintendent or his authorized designee does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received the following Thursday at the same time and place specified above and each Thursday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. Further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address.
Legal Opinion: Bowie, Arneson, Kadi, Wiles & Giannone, Newport Beach, California.
